title: Not Able To Switch Models As A Max User
body:
Getting this when I launch Claude Code.

"Claude Pro users are not currently able to use Opus 4 in Claude Code. The current model is now Sonnet 4."

I've tried logging out and back in and reinstalling claude. Currently running Claude with cursor
author: drewschettler

top_comments.author: teito-dev
top_comments.body: I'm getting the same issue, i'm a paying claude user, and just got opus removed from being able to use it. I literally paid the extra $100 money to be able to access that, is this a joke ? I tried logging in, logging out, uninstalling claude, installing a week old claude code version, installing the latest claude code version. None of them worked

top_comments.body: I signed up for this plan *yesterday* simply because my Opus usage was costing me more than having a plan to begin with. Where is the communication?
